title: [HI] [HI] German Prepositional Verbs
rules: Verb + feste Präposition + Kasus / Wo(r)- + Präposition?

example_translations.ex_de_b2_2: Worauf wartest du? Ich warte auf den Bus.

common_error_explanations.err_de_b2_2: Many German verbs require a specific fixed preposition and case, and questions for things use pronominal adverbs like 'wo(r)- + preposition'.
